text:
olivia: Opening follow-up for the slow-residency OOM signals on prod-kv (shard-4) observed ~06:40 UTC. logging owners here.
lee: uploaded heap diffs: gs://redwood/prof/2474509876/diff.tar.gz. early: many 48B allocs from index.encoder paths.
jonathan: mitigation proposal: 1) pool hot buffers (low-risk) -> owner @sam_k -> PR by tomorrow AM; 2) per-shard soft-residency guard (percentile-driven) -> owner @jonathan -> design PR Wed; 3) compacting cadence probe + jemalloc tunables -> owner @mira -> canary metrics Thu.
mira: will run compact_every=4m on canary and post fragmentation + residency_ratio graphs.
sam_k: sketching sync.Pool patch and microbenchmarks; early local results show ~36% alloc rate reduction. pairing with lee for correctness.
ops-bot: canary deploy "pool-probe-v1" started at 2474509950 (shards 4/20).
lee: flamegraph link: gs://redwood/prof/2474509876/flame.svg. allocation stack: encoder.encode -> persist.write -> cache.entry. also see jemalloc fragmentation tick up.
olivia: added tracking sheet with owners/dates: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/track-2474509876. weekly close sync scheduled Fri 09:00 PT.
jonathan: soft-residency rollout plan: canary -> 10% -> 50% -> full, rollback if OOMs >0.5% or tail latency increases beyond SLO. make thresholds per-shard based on p95 seq_len.
lee: note: if pooling reduces alloc churn but residency persists, fallback = aggressive compact + targeted eviction for sequences older than 10m.
mira: will instrument seq_len histograms per shard and add alert: p95_seq_len>900 && residency_ratio>1.15.
sam_k: opening branch feat/pool-idxbufs-2474; will add bench results and mention rollback steps in PR.
olivia: thanks team. i'll update postmortem with owners, tickets, and the customer comms draft. follow-up actions documented in the sheet.
